verdict.rationale: Better Auth's first-party twoFactor plugin documents TOTP authenticator-app setup as the default second factor, alongside email/SMS OTP, backup codes for account recovery, and trusted-device management. The evidence never shows a way to require MFA for all users or roles, or to enforce step-up re-authentication for sensitive actions. missing for 10: documented mandatory-MFA policy enforcement, step-up authentication for sensitive operations, independent or hands-on corroboration of the 2FA flow.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can require multi-factor authentication with TOTP authenticator apps and backup codes, with step-up enforcement where needed
